title: Error
description: The one stderr line of a failed command with --json. stdout is empty.

code.description: usage, config, invalid_argument, not_found, unauthenticated, precondition_failed, conflict, rate_limited, unavailable, interrupted, internal (values may be added)

retryable.description: true when the change may have been applied: retry with the same clientId

clientId.description: The operation's clientId (pass it as --client-id to retry)

ref.description: The task that failed, in a command given several tasks
